WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count
    FROM order_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count,
           oc.order_count - oa.avg_order_count AS above_overall_average
    FROM order_counts AS oc
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_order_count
)
SELECT account_id, order_count, above_overall_average,
       above_overall_average - AVG(above_overall_average) OVER () AS above_kept_average
FROM above_average
ORDER BY above_kept_average DESC
LIMIT 10
